The day that comes after Monday is Tuesday.

Regarding the cloud computing-related security issues in the text, the primary vulnerability stems from the failure to clearly define security responsibilities within the shared security model. In a shared security model, the cloud provider and the customer have distinct roles. By not defining the internal IT team's responsibilities, the company has created a gap where neither party may be addressing specific security controls. This ambiguity can lead to misconfigurations in data storage (such as improper encryption or access controls) and access vulnerabilities (such as excessive permissions or lack of monitoring), as critical security tasks may be overlooked or assumed to be handled by the other party.
